subject: a red plum branch after snow
requested_medium: fine ink and mineral pigment painting
art_direction: 细枝红梅从右下伸入奶白雪雾，少量花朵和积雪形成克制的亮色。
visible_description: 细枝红梅从右下伸入奶白雪雾，少量花朵和积雪形成克制的亮色。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Paint a slim plum branch extending diagonally from the lower right, carrying a few muted-red blossoms and soft traces of settled snow. Use mineral pigment for the petals and varied ink for the bark. Keep the branch bends deliberate and the blossom count sparse. Warm-white paper and faint cool wash suggest winter air without a literal heavy snowfall. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
